page_title: MNT 0-2 HAV | Montpellier v Le Havre 06/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Referee Benoit Bastien seems to have made up his mind after reviewing the incident using VAR, and it’s RED for Abdoul Bamo Meite (Montpellier).

90+5' There's a break in play and the referee must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier infringement by Abdoul Bamo Meite (Montpellier) using VAR. This could result in a red card!
90+4' The referee blows his whistle as Abdoul Bamo Meite (Montpellier) was too aggressive in his challenge.
90+2' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Le Havre was in an offside position.
90+1' Benoit Bastien shows a yellow card to Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) for his blatant foul.
90+1' Mathieu Gorgelin (Le Havre) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block.
88' A substitution has been made. Modibo Sagnan goes off and Simon Cara (Montpellier) comes on.
86' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
86' Benoit Bastien blows his whistle and signals a foul after Wilfried Ndollo Bille (Montpellier) brought his opponent down. Le Havre have a free kick.
85' Didier Digard has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Etienne Youte Kinkoue (Le Havre) replacing Arouna Sangante.
85' We are about to witness a subsitution. Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) for Koka.
83' Othmane Maamma (Montpellier) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
83' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
82' The resulting set piece from Le Havre is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

81' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) has an effort from distance and sends the ball towards the right post, but the goalkeeper is equal to it. The ball goes out for a corner. Le Havre can continue in their attacking effort.
80' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went way over the bar.
80' The referee signals a corner kick to Montpellier.

79' Nicolas Pays (Montpellier) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Montpellier will take a corner.
78' Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Benoit Bastien saw the whole situation. It's a free kick to Le Havre in a dangerous position.
77' Othmane Maamma (Montpellier) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andre Ayew (Le Havre) comes onto the pitch for Antoine Joujou.
73' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
72' Nicolas Pays (Montpellier) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Mathieu Gorgelin reacts superbly to deny him.
71' Wilfried Ndollo Bille (Montpellier) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
68' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Montpellier comes to nothing.
67' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
65' Substitution. Andy Delort is replaced by Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier).
64' Didier Digard has decided to substitute Josue Casimir and he is replaced by Mahamadou Diawara (Le Havre).
64' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Yassine Kechta walks off the pitch to be replaced by Issa Soumare (Le Havre).
62' Superb ball control by Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) as he latches on to a cross and smashes it against the crossbar! What a strike, this one was really close.
61' The Montpellier players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
57' Mathieu Gorgelin makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded low towards the middle of the goal by Othmane Maamma (Montpellier) after a cross from the side.
56' A substitution has been made. Falaye Sacko is replaced by Wilfried Ndollo Bille (Montpellier).
56' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Othmane Maamma (Montpellier) is coming onto the pitch as Tanguy Coulibaly cannot continue after picking up an injury.
56' Jean-Louis Gasset decides to make a substitution. Joris Chotard will be replaced by Khalil Fayad (Montpellier).
55' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Josue Casimir (Le Havre).
54' Montpellier fail to score from a corner as Mathieu Gorgelin (Le Havre) leaps to collect the ball.
54' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Montpellier have a corner.

52' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
50' Andy Delort (Montpellier) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Le Havre, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
49' Falaye Sacko (Montpellier) sends a cross into the box, but Mathieu Gorgelin comes off his line to gather the ball.
47' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Benoit Bastien blows for a foul. Le Havre win a free kick.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+6' A player from Le Havre commits a rough challenge. Benoit Bastien blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Montpellier will take a free kick.
45+3' Montpellier failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

45+3' Mathieu Gorgelin stretches to his right side and makes a brilliant save! Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper into the top right corner. Montpellier force a corner. They send men into the box.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Nicolas Pays (Montpellier) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
42' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Montpellier.

41' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Corner kick. Montpellier will have an opportunity.
40' A poorly taken free kick by Yassine Kechta (Le Havre)! He sends a shot from the edge of the box into the defensive wall.
39' Benoit Bastien blows the whistle, Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) is penalised for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Le Havre.
37' Falaye Sacko (Montpellier) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
35' Benoit Bastien interrupts the game. One of the players from Le Havre won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. A free kick has been awarded to Montpellier.
33' 0 - 2 What an absolute cracking goal! Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) hits a perfect volley from long range and the ball flies into the bottom right corner. Take a bow son.
32' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
31' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
31' Nicolas Pays (Montpellier) brings an opponent down and Benoit Bastien interrupts the game. Le Havre are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
30' Andy Delort (Montpellier) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent. A free kick has been awarded to Le Havre.
29' Falaye Sacko (Montpellier) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
26' A cooling break is underway.
25' Benoit Bastien blows his whistle for a foul after Joris Chotard (Montpellier) hacks down one of his opponents. Le Havre have a free kick.
23' Andy Delort (Montpellier) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the left post is denied by a decent save from Mathieu Gorgelin.
21' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
19' A cross from a corner kick by Le Havre is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Montpellier.
18' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. Le Havre force their opponents to concede a corner.
17' Nicolas Pays (Montpellier) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
15' Nicolas Pays (Montpellier) picks up an injury.
15' Wasted effort! Josue Casimir (Le Havre) drives to the edge of the box after picking up a rebound, but his shot is tame and bends well wide of the left post.
14' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
12' Nicolas Pays (Montpellier) dribbles his way into the box and has an effort on goal, but the ball flies well wide of the left post.
11' Benoit Bastien blows his whistle and it's Joris Chotard (Montpellier) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Le Havre are awarded the free kick.
9' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) is able to continue to play.
8' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Le Havre, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
8' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
7' Falaye Sacko (Montpellier) commits a rough challenge and Benoit Bastien blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Le Havre.
6' Golden opportunity! Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass.
5' A player from Montpellier commits a rough challenge. Benoit Bastien blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Free kick. Le Havre will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
3' 0 - 1 Goal! Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 0:1.

3' A neat pass is well received by Josue Casimir (Le Havre), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
2' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) hits an explosive shot from outside the penalty area and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.

1' Andy Delort (Montpellier) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and drills a good shot to the middle of the goal. Mathieu Gorgelin shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop the effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Montpellier will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Benoit Bastien.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
